scope: One bounded fixed-cell shared-beta support-initialization solve, then one exact local API validation on all9 cases/144 goal pairs. No new simulator data or full NLL fitting.
basis: The six local labels remain zero under all registered infinitesimal probes. Component one-sided derivatives are verified, but the joint NLL cannot start at beta0. A support candidate must precede any attempt at NLL optimization.
budget_accounting: Finding beta from these training-label constraints is one new parameter-estimation/fitting operation, even though it is not a Gaussian or joint-NLL fit. Count the single LP solver invocation separately and in the total optimizer-call ledger; do not disguise it as zero-fit analysis.
fixed_data: The same9 training cases, frozen current frames, original38 feature definitions/scales and history priors. All-frame phi arrays are already server-side. No calibration or evaluation labels.
branch_registration: Before solving, register one goal/action branch per case. For the six unresolved cases use the already documented representative goal pairs and feasible focal/denier action pattern. For the three restored controls use the first saved positive-zero-mass goal pair and first executable zero-residual lateral tuple in the existing deterministic enumeration order. Do not choose new branches after seeing solver outcomes.
constraints: Construct affine endpoint front/rear gap inequalities for each registered sequence, including every earlier landing action needed by the control. Use the same38 beta for every feature row. Explicitly register the clipping cell of every motion term: linear residuals require -b<=beta dot phi<=0, a positive plateau has effective residual0, and a zero-speed floor must be represented in its actual cell. Do not use an unbounded raw score difference in place of clipped motion. Keep frozen minimum gaps unchanged.
single_solver: One scipy linprog(method=highs) call, maximum60s, fixed row/column order and existing single-thread environment. Variables are beta plus absolute-value auxiliaries; minimize sum absolute beta in the existing scaled coordinates. Use the solver's deterministic returned optimum if tied; no second objective or tie-breaking solve. No probability floor, physical margin adjustment or coefficient perturbation retry.
validation: Regardless of LP feasibility, preserve the returned status/certificate. If a candidate exists, evaluate it once through the supplied-beta API on all144 positive goal pairs with beta applied to every current packet, including background dependencies. Report normalized probabilities, endpoint-compatible mass, all9 observed-class supports, strict caps/LC ordering/boundaries and motion-density changes; preserve the prior3 controls. Do not substitute the affine LP output for actual shared responses.
decision: If infeasible or the actual API does not retain all9 supports/geometry conditions, stop on HOLD with the original evidence; do not switch clipping cells, goal branches or thresholds. A fixed-cell infeasibility or validation failure is not a model-family impossibility proof. A feasible support point is not automatically differentiable or a prediction improvement.
after: Stop after this one candidate and validation. No automatic160000-record rebuild, joint-NLL optimization, calibration, rollout, paper update or model admission. Any subsequent fitting/validation budget must be specified separately.
acceptance: Report candidate as local support-initialization only if all9 prior-marginal observed-class endpoint-compatible masses are positive, all conditional class and endpoint-compatible total masses normalize under the existing numerical tolerance, and the old3 controls remain supported. Otherwise HOLD; no new physical gap tolerance or probability floor.
